lines.dialogue: Sure. Batman gunslingers out his grapple speargun. The wired hook rockets past the clown's jerking away head and into the wall behind him.
Gotta go. In a wink, he's a half-block away, being schmoozed by Commissioner Gordon. Onlookers CHEER. It's just Selina alone here with her unconscious attacker.
We'll see... Now the Mayor bustles up.
The Red Triangle Circus Gang ... they're jackals, Alfred. They hunt in packs, at night --
Funny you should ask, Alfred. Maybe I am a bit concerned.
Admiring your handiwork?
You're not the Mayor.
Once you were their freak, now these clowns do your bidding. Must feel pretty good.
What're you really after?

Things change. Penguin is fashioning a retort, when both men suddenly turn, mesmerized, to the sight of Catwoman coming toward them from out of Shreck's department store, startling back flip by startling back flip. She does a final somersault and lands on her feet, ten yards away.
"Shreck's." You -- Catwoman launches a brutal kick in Batman's face. Batman vibrates back a few steps, then comes forward and slams Catwoman into a whimpering ball. She looks up, shocked.

(suddenly taken aback) I'm -- sorry, I -- Catwoman spins, pounding Batman off the ledge. Then lashes out her whip, coiling it around Batman's flapping arm. With both hands, she jerks him up. Lashes her end of the whip to a weather vane.
Hanging on every word.
A "he-man"? Sure. They shine that beacon in the sky, then wonder what hole I crawl out of.
I just can't sleep at night. Exploding department stores keep me up. One ... He snaps the tube. As the blue seeps into the red and the tube slowly glows purple ...

...four, five. He lobs the now-bubbling tube as Catwoman starts to sever the whip. The mixture explodes against her forearm. She SHRIEKS like a dying cat and soars down onto the next ledge, barely. Batman leaps down, to her. Her talons frantically claw and scratch as she tries not to plummet. Batman grabs her, pulls her up -- for a moment, they're embracing.
-- No -- He watches in shock as her body hurtles toward the ground.
The bitch. Then he buzzes for his butler.
Alfred ... Would you bring me some antiseptic ointment, please?
My ego, mostly.
... Meow.
Gotta hurry. I was set up to look like I did this --
We do. He head-butts her. But Catwoman quickly recovers, then back-flips to the Princess and talons her free. Tosses the chair at Batman as she drags the squealing Princess through a door.
Okay .. just slowly move toward me ... away from the edge ... As the Ice Princess takes a tentative step forward:

No -- don't panic -- Batman bounds to her aid, but the Ice Princess steps back, away from the bats, losing her balance ... One sweeping Klieg-light catches Batman as he rushes at the Ice Princess, arms outstretched to save her. The other Klieg lights the Princess herself, as she topples off the building!
Wait --
A kiss under the misteltoe. Mistletoe can be deadly, if you eat it ...
I tried to grab you -- save you --
That's funny... The buildings loom before the windshield.
Now I'm a little worried....Oh. Batman connects two wires.
I'm homing in on the signal's origin...

Got the coordinates. They're -- Two penguins suddenly appear before Batman, firing their payloads. Batman savagely curls his boat all the way up the oval pipe until he is momentarily upside down. He swooshes back down past the penguins and the twin explosions.
As I was saying...
... 28 degrees west. Shall we?
Maybe you're right. Penguin jumps down, off Batman.
First you're gonna shut up. Then you're gonna turn yourself in.
Wrong on both counts. He tries to grab Max, but Catwoman makes a lunge for Batman's abdomen sending him reeling. He picks himself up, then, talking in a calming, soothing way:
Why are you doing this? Let's just take him to the police, then go home together ... She's still for a moment, considering.
Don't you see, we're the same... split down the middle... please... Batman rips off his mask, looks straight at her.

You're trespassing, Ratbreath. Nick looks down. Far, far below, CARS wink silently past. He looks up. And sees, in the mirrored lenses where Batman's eyes should be, the twin reflections of his own stricken face.

Tell your friends. Tell all your friends. I AM the night. Nick HOWLS. Batman heaves him roughly back onto the tar- and-gravel surface of the roof. And then -- casually, without a moment's hesitation -- steps off the ledge, into midair. Trembling, Nick crawls to the ledge and looks over...
CUT TO:
GET IN THE CAR!
Ignition! As he sprints down the alley, a COMPUTER DISPLAY on the dashboard registers his unique voiceprint. A tinny, synthesized VOICE repeats the command:
Damn!
Too many people. Come on! (as she scrambles out) SHIELDS!! The BATMOBILE'S computerized VOICE replies:
How much do you weigh?

HANG ON! THUGS pile out of the car. The BATARANG catches on the catwalk, and Batman triggers the spring-action REEL on his utility belt. BULLETS zing past as Batman and Vicki WHIP UPWARD like fish on a line. One story; two stories; and then... They slow. They STOP. They DANGLE IN MIDAIR as the Joker's GOONS advance. Batman wriggles, twists. Vicki SCREAMS. Her additional weight is too much for the reel mechanism. They're stranded two stories up -- SITTING DUCKS.

Whatever happens -- DON'T LET GO!! He's detached the reel from his own waist and hitched it around Vicki's belt. He LETS GO. Vicki rockets upward at blinding speed, SHRIEKING all the way. Batman, his cape billowing, PLUMMETS DOWNWARD. Vicki SLAMS up into the catwalk and bobs on the line as Batman lands with a loud CRASH, overturning a row of garbage cans. The GOONS are on him in a flash. Batman manages to slam two GOONS into a wall, but before he can get to his feet, GOON III slams a lead pipe into the back of his skull. THUGS circle around him. The LEAD THUG holds his col- leagues back, draws his gun, and fires TWO SHOTS, point- blank, at the yellow-and-black INSIGNIA on Batman's chest. The body jerks; they edge closer -- and stop.
Shields open.
Ignition.
Not even a 'thank you'?
You weigh a little more than 103. SIRENS APPROACH. Batman takes her gently by the shoulders.
You'd better come with me.

STOP! BRAKES SQUEAL. The BATMOBILE stops one yard short of Batman and Vicki. A moment later Batman is AT THE WHEEL. SIRENS BUILD. LIGHTS FLASH. THE COP CARS are now visible behind them. Batman floors the pedal; the Bat- mobile's powerful AFTERBURNERS kick in; and the hapless cops KILL THEIR SIRENS as BATMAN zooms off into the night at 140 mph. DISSOLVE TO:
Looks like it.

Watch your step in here. Vicki stops just over the edge of a DEEP BLACK PIT. She kicks a pebble over. Long seconds pass; no sound. She looks up. Suspended over the bottomless pit are a pair of gymnast's rings. She backs away. SUDDENLY Vicki's HEAD jerks up abruptly. In the dim recesses overhead, BATS ARE SCREAMING. She shivers.
That's the idea. Batman pats the cage of a WOUNDED BAT, its wing is splinted.
They're also great survivors. Vicki steps away, repulsed. Batman is rustling papers. She can't see what he's doing. She begins to examine a row of bat-suits hanging nearby.
It doesn't have a name. While he seems pleased at Vicki's fascination with his lair, he nevertheless remains guarded. Vicki moves toward Batman, intent on getting a close look at him.

You're going to do something for me. Vicki again begins to approach Batman. Keeping in shadow, he moves behind a lab table. On the table, amid the beakers and test tubes, are dozens of TAINTED PRODUCTS: makeup, deodorant, etc. Nearby, a COMPUTER PRINTER begins to CHATTER; Vicki watches information scrolling across the main monitor.
The police have got it wrong. They're looking for one product. It's much bigger than that. The Joker's tainted hundreds of basic chemicals at the source.
No. Each product only contains one component. The poison only works when they're mixed. Hair spray won't do it alone. But... hair spray and perfume and lipstick will be toxic and -- Untraceable.
Take this to the press. He hands her a thick envelope. She looks it over cautiously.
Do me a favor. Don't flatter my enemy. The man's psychotic.
What people?
It's not a normal world. Vicki stares at him. She's suddenly chilled.
(A BEAT; then from another direction) People need that information.
You're right, I could have. There is something else. She looks down. She has backed up nearly to the gaping hole.
You have something I want. Batman suddenly steps very close to her. She holds her hand to her breast.
Just when murderous clowns leave the circus. Let him go.
What do you want from this city?

Joker! Joker looks at him. Batman materializes a Joker card. Joker looks at it and Batman sucker PUNCHES him in the face as the Mayor rolls away. Joker rolls backward and zips to his feet. He looks around as GOONS FLEE.
Thanks.

Whatever you say. Vicki snaps a photo. Batman looks at her for a beat, a hint of disappointment. POLICE SIRENS. Batman FIRES a line up to the building and ZOOMS UP the line to the top. He disappears as Vicki shoots pix.
(pointing to a large chunk of metal tethering his cape) Kick that! Vicki kicks it. The cape is free. Batman walks by her like a knight from hell.

My parents are dead. But you remember that, don't you, Jack? Joker turns quickly to see Batman standing with cape un- furled. A rappeling line hangs from his belt and out onto the parapet. A small pulley on the belt. The Joker CACKLES.
Yeah, and they asked me to bring your face back to the shop for some work. Even if I have to tear it off.
I made you. And you made me.
Are we going to kill each other, Jack?

Well, when you see him -- tell him I'm gonna kick his ass! Batman steps in Joker's direction. From out of the dark- ness Joker swings a huge BELL which SMASHES INTO BATMAN. He is knocked over backwards out onto the parapet, he nearly falls over the edge. BATMAN'S POV OF GROUND ZERO - NIGHT A frightening view thirty stories down toward death.
Have you danced with the devil in the pale moonlight? Joker jumps off the ground. He tries to get away. Batman wraps his other arm around and, "click," hand- cuffs himself to the Joker.
Well, now's your big chance. Joker struggles. He twists and turns the handcuffs but can't shift them. He can hardly move.
